title: My Son Stole My $130K Reverse Mortgage, Then Locked Me Out. So I Foreclosed On Their Dream Home
description: When my son and daughter-in-law begged me to take a $130K reverse mortgage for my grandson's tuition, they signed a note promising to repay me with interest and a suite in their new house. They used my money to build a dream home, then locked me out and called it a gift. I sued and won a $220K judgment, foreclosed, and now rent rooms to college students while sending them monthly "Education Costs" statements. #familybetrayal #revenge #karma
thumb_text: MY $130K BUILT THEIR DREAM HOME. I FORECLOSED ON IT.
pinned_comment: If your son used your $130K reverse mortgage to build a dream house and then locked you out, would you have sued and foreclosed or just walked away? Share your story below.
